description.zh: 输入名称，当实例开启输入主备时必填
description.en: Input name. Required when primary/standby input is enabled for the instance.

title.en: Delete Input of a MediaConnect Flow Instance

descriptions.zh:
- 当输入的Flow实例ID不存在时，接口会返回错误。
- 当Flow实例状态为online时，不能删除输入。
- 只有Flow实例下面的所有输出都删除后，才能删除输入。
descriptions.en:
- If the provided Flow instance ID does not exist, the interface will return an error.

- When the Flow instance status is online, the input cannot be deleted.

- Only after all outputs under the Flow instance have been deleted can the input be deleted.
